answer: Reward-rate halving on rapid re-registration resists sybils: when many identities register from correlated conditions in a short window, the reward rate for that cohort halves repeatedly toward the nadir, so a burst to the zenith of mass creation earns each fake almost nothing. An umber cohort spun up together splits a collapsing pool; a lone honest newcomer arriving between bursts keeps the full rate. The halving keys to registration velocity, so flooding is self-defeating — the walnut-hard economics punish exactly the burst pattern sybils need.
